touches.text: PURPOSE: The system's notary: runs proofs and seals their verdicts.
WHY: Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass, and the verdict must come from a hand the builder did not guide. A green cannot be self-granted.
Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
A timed-out run is its own outcome, not red (ticket 3dfceaa272ec).
Test runs are transient (30 days, 4.3.2); seals are records of truth (git).
TOOLS: base, validation_store, proof_coverage, scratch, question, proof_discovery, chain, bus_client, artifact, system_word; machines ruling, build_inspector; db client
COMMANDS: cairn test (--hollow, --seal, --exec, …) → cairn codemother test, the CLI a client of her verb
